messages:
Alex K: hey team :wave: quick q — what's the deadline for the mandatory security training? and i'm tagged for the phishing sim next tues but i'll be traveling. can i opt out? also i'm on a personal mac, do i need to swap for a company laptop to finish setup?
Jordyn (People Ops): welcome Alex! :tada: training is due within 7 days of your start date — you should see it in the Learning Portal. link: https://learning.redwood.ai/training/security-basics
Jordyn (People Ops): phish sims are required for everyone, but we can put a short exemption for travel if you can't complete it in that window. do you have a date range you're out?
Alex K: i'm out 2111112899-2111113422 (overnight flights + conference). would that work for a short exemption? :slightly_smiling_face:
Samira (Security): hi Alex — thanks for the heads up. we don't do blanket opt-outs, but we can move the sim window for your account by ~2 weeks. if you're gone longer or have an accommodation reason, file an accommodation request via HR and we can exempt you. for travel, a shifted window is fine.
Samira (Security): also FYI the security training includes a short module on phishing and a tiny practical quiz — should take ~20-30 mins. it's monitored for compliance only, not punitive.
it-bot: Reminder: New user Alex K assigned course "Security Basics" — due 7 days from 2111112222.
Mike (IT): re: Mac — you don't strictly need a company laptop, but we require device enrollment in MDM and FileVault enabled. if you keep your personal device, we need full-disk encryption + company profile installed.
Mike (IT): steps for mac enrollment (shortcut):
```
1) System Preferences -> Profiles -> Enroll in Redwood MDM
2) Install "Redwood Device Agent" from https://it.redwood.ai/downloads
3) Enable FileVault in System Preferences -> Security & Privacy -> FileVault
4) Register your device in the portal: https://it.redwood.ai/devices -> + Add device
```
Mike (IT): if you prefer, we can ship a laptop. to request one ping me with your shipping address.
Alex K: thanks — i'll try to enroll tonight. if i hit issues i'll ping you, Mike. can you also confirm whether yubikey is required for MFA or optional?
Samira (Security): YubiKey is strongly recommended for SRE/platform engineers but currently optional for most new hires. you'll need to set up 2FA (TOTP or a hardware key) for SSO. if you want a YubiKey shipped we can do that but there's a short approval step.
Jordyn (People Ops): re: phishing sim window — Alex i'll mark you for a 14-day shift. you should get a new schedule email. if travel changes, DM me and we'll adjust. :thumbsup:
Alex K: awesome, thank you all. one more tiny ask — do I need to accept any additional privacy/KMS Agreements before enrolling device?
Samira (Security): there's a device policy acknowledgement during enrollment — it includes device monitoring and key handling basics. no separate KMS agreement unless you request access to encryption keys.
Mike (IT): FYI if enrollment fails on macOS 13+, try this local command to refresh profiles:
```bash
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```
Mike (IT): if that fails, paste the enroll log (Console -> /var/log/install.log or Profiles logs) and i'll take a look.
Alex K: great, i'll enroll and report back. thanks everyone :raised_hands: 
Jordyn (People Ops): welcome again Alex. ping here if you need any followups, we'll keep track of the exemption. :sparkles:
